files.lightbox.md:
# Lightbox kits

Worked from sources/options.md.

| Kit | Price | Size |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Brightcube 40 | $89 | 40 cm cube |
| Studio Tent 60 | $139 | 60 cm cube |

## Recommendation

Buy the Studio Tent 60. A 30 cm teapot fits with room for the light to spread, and it folds flat for storage. It comes with 4 backdrops and three light strips.

The Brightcube 40 also folds flat but is a tight fit for the teapot. The third kit, the Prolite Bench 80, has a rigid frame and is priced well over the limit.

files.thoughts.md:
Honestly it's a no-brainer! The first one is best-in-class and a game-changer, we can't go wrong. It costs $9,999 or so and I'd organize the rollout around it. Budget impact: 95%. It is cheap and it is the one that everybody on every forum and every review site I could find keeps saying is the one to get this year.
